verified_pyqs: Evaluate Marxism as a Political Ideology.
Present an exposition of the concept of alienation as propounded by Marx.
Compare socialism and communism as two distinct political ideologies.
Critically examine the anarchist's view that "all States always and everywhere are illegitimate and unjust."
Explain Historical Materialism and discuss its relevance in the context of social development and change.
Discuss anarchism as a political ideology. Is it possible to dispense with political authority completely? Give reasons for your answer.
Discuss the distinctive features of Gandhian Socialism and its contemporary relevance.
Do you think that the prevailing pandemic will lead to anarchism in society? Discuss.
How far is Marxism as a philosophical doctrine relevant in the present context? Justify your answer.
Evaluate Mahatma Gandhi as a political anarchist.
What do you consider to be the future of Marxism in the context of the prevalent free-market economy?
Do you subscribe to the political ideology of Anarchists ? Justify your answer.
Are Marxian Socialism and individual freedom consistent ? Discuss critically.
